set.body:
Sibling functions in the same package spell the same concept differently.

  fmri_meta(..., robust = "none")   - 27 call sites across tests and R/
  fmri_lm(...,  robust = FALSE)     - "none" is rejected:
      'robust' must be NULL, logical, or one of 'huber', 'bisquare'

Surfaced while auditing fmri_lm's argument surface. Supports the decision to make
robust_spec(type = "none") the only spelling on the new interface - "none" is
already house style next door. Align fmri_meta onto the same spec vocabulary when
the specs land, or at minimum accept both spellings in both places.
set.title: Inconsistency: fmri_meta uses robust='none' while fmri_lm uses robust=FALSE
